verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing showing that macOS offers an API covering everything its UI can do. The Shortcuts automation feature and a few built-in command-line utilities (pbcopy/pbpaste, qlmanage, hidutil, networkQuality) are related but different features that expose only narrow slices of functionality. The probes found no OpenAPI or other machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
